poll.question: Dan and Hui Ling sit by the fire as dusk settles. The first quiet moment without fighting between them. The battery is at 45%. Does the fire burn warm through the night,

options.label: Keep the fire warm
options.desc: Hold this moment—the warmth, the peace, each other. Tomorrow is tomorrow.

options.label: Bank the fire now
options.desc: Survival first. The harder nights are coming. They'll need the charge.

options.label: Embers, not flames
options.desc: Warmth without waste. They can stay close. That's enough.

in_play.label: Dan moves aside
in_play.desc: Caging her will cost him far more than the birds ever will.
